_note: Hand-written expected answers (written by a person, not by the model). Keys are aspect words that must appear inside an extracted aspect; values are the correct sentiment. 'none' means the review has no product feature. 'in_scope' marks product types the models were trained/tested on. 'contested': true marks cases where the expected label follows one reading of mild wording (okay / average / so-so = neutral); on real annotated reviews these words are labelled positive more often than neutral, so those cases are reported separately and are not part of the pass-rate guard.
